A.text: Alveoli have goblet cells to produce mucus to trap pathogens from the air.

B.text: Cartilage in the bronchi keeps the bronchi open and allows air to flow through freely.

C.text: Complete rings of cartilage in the bronchioles make sure that air can reach the alveoli.

D.text: During exercise, muscles in the bronchioles and alveoli relax to allow a greater flow of air.
